title: How Artemis II's Heat Shield Beat Artemis I (NASA, Oct. 15, 2026)
description:
NASA's Oct. 15, 2026 analysis confirms the Artemis II heat shield performed as expected. After Artemis I, NASA shortened the maximum downrange distance Orion could fly through the atmosphere, so the shield spent less time in the temperature range where the Artemis I damage happened. Engineers found nine spots of char loss on Artemis II, compared to 103 on Artemis I. NASA updates its Moon plans, Artemis III included, on Friday, Oct. 23, at 2 p.m. EDT.
